On a punctual start, rules for the ramp team
This section explains the steps for the whole desk
Companion Animal Travel Desk Operating Guide

Purpose: keep pet travel smooth, calm, and safe for every guest and every animal.

Staff should greet travelers with steady manners, confirm crate condition, and review basic care notes before the handoff moves forward. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. If a traveler arrives worried, the desk keeps the tone friendly and clear, checks the paperwork again, and makes sure the animal is comfortable before any next step. The senior coordinator should watch for signs of stress, offer water when allowed, and pass any concern to the cabin team without delay. A cabin team monitors animals during flight. 

The desk also keeps records neat, matches baggage tags to the right booking, and speaks plainly when a carrier needs inspection or a follow-up note. If a crate looks loose, damaged, or poorly ventilated, service pauses until the issue is fixed. When a traveler asks for help, staff should explain the process in simple words and avoid rushing the exchange.

For support, contact the duty coordinator or the operations desk.
